company_name: University of Hyogo, Toyoda & Takeuchi Lab.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the University of Hyogo, Toyoda & Takeuchi Lab specializes in advanced etching technologies relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: The University of Hyogo, Toyoda & Takeuchi Lab focuses on gas cluster ion beam (GCIB) technology, which is utilized for low-damage processing and high-precision surface treatment in semiconductor applications. Their research includes innovative etching techniques that enhance surface quality and uniformity, making them a valuable contributor to the semiconductor equipment sector.
capabilities: Low-temperature, halogen-free etching technology using GCIB
Position-controlled GCIB irradiation for improved in-plane uniformity

regional_presence.Japan: The lab is based in Japan and focuses on developing technologies that originate from the region.
